meta.triageRationale: bugfix (small): one function in one file reads the Story trailer through git's last-paragraph trailer parser.

body.focus: Count a commit as the Story's when any whole line of its message is `Insrc-Story: <storyKey>`, in whichever paragraph it sits (ISSUE-f431a4420d03374f): fix scanTrailers in src/workflow/runners/build/story-commits.ts and pin both message shapes and the non-matching ones in a test.
body.summary: scanTrailers in src/workflow/runners/build/story-commits.ts now reads the full message (%B) instead of git's last-paragraph trailer placeholder; a new storyLines() returns the key of every whole `Insrc-Story: <key>` line. A Story line in any paragraph counts (the shape that dropped Epic 8315a11f s1's t5-t12 commits); a mention inside other text, another Story's key, or a key with a suffix do not. Tests on real git repositories pin both shapes and the non-matching ones; 3 mutations (back to the trailer parser, a mention counting, a prefix key match) each fail a test. Commit 973fc8bd.
